info.title: Fivexer Platform API
info.description: Routing-as-a-service: create workers and tasks, the platform matches continuously. `/v1` authenticates with a workspace API key (`Authorization: Bearer sk_...`); `/console` with a session token from `/auth`; `/admin` with the operator token.

supervisorToken.description: Supervisor session token (sv_...), scoped to one workspace and optionally one team
